main_text.l: POSTERIOREM D. PAVLI APOSTOLI AD CORINTHIOS EPISTOLAM HOMILIAE,

ACCESSIT operi Præfatio ad Illustrem et generosissimum D. LVDOVICVM Comitem Vuitgensteinium, &c. De Apostolica doctrinæ authoritate et perfectione, qua tam ipsa quàm eius ministri contra aduersariorum calumnias defenduntur. INDEX item rerum et locorum Scripturæ, quæ toto hoc libro explicantur.
Ecce agnus ille Dei, qui tollit peccatum mundi.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving in the centre (tree with figure and town landscape) described, not transcribed. The printed "POSTERIOREM D·PAVLI" has a centred dot as printed.
